name: Partnership outreach
description: For proposing an integration, a co-marketing push, or a referral arrangement. Leads with the overlap in customers, not with what you want, and asks for the right person early rather than pitching the wrong one.
audience: Partnerships, BD, and product leads at companies selling to the same buyer as you without competing for the same budget.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — we sell to the same buyer as {{company|your company}} without competing for the same budget. Worth being connected on that basis alone.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — our customers keep asking whether we work with {{company|you}}. Connecting so I can find out whether we should.

Thanks {{firstName|there}}. Concretely: our users end up in {{company|your product}} straight after they finish with us, and the handover is manual. That looks like an integration to me. Who owns that on your side?
Here's the overlap, {{firstName|there}}: same buyer, sequential workflow, no integration between us. Are you the right person for that conversation, or can you point me at them?
{{firstName|Hi}} — happy to bring a one-page version: the overlap, what we'd each build, and what it's worth. Half an hour whenever suits.
I can put the whole thing on one page before we speak, {{firstName|there}} — scope, effort, and the number. Want me to send it?
I'll park this, {{firstName|there}}. If partnerships come back onto the roadmap at {{company|your company}}, we'd still be a good fit.
Closing the loop, {{firstName|there}}. Not a no, just not now — I'll come back in a couple of quarters.
